strings.en: Blast, who on earth are they? If they hadn't suddenly appeared,
we'd have crossed the Karakara and entered Tartara!
It seems the Aura Road opened and surface machines came down.
That many at once...
What is happening in this Byston Well?
I don't know... But it does seem the Aura Road opens more easily now.
Holy Warrior Show Zama, and now Todd's unit gone missing...
Are these recent disappearances due to the Aura Road opening?
Todd's unit lost contact right after encountering
those bone-like enemies that suddenly appeared.
You mean they opened the Aura Road...
I see. To think that's happening on the surface...
While I was on the surface, did anything change here?
Come to think of it, Drake's Todd Guinness went missing too. Maybe...?
Yeah, I ran into him in New York.
So... Todd's on the surface too...
Yeah, he's with the Gandor Team on the surface.
He's one of your comrades?
He should be fighting the invaders on the surface right now.
Todd helping you, Show...
You two! Never mind that, what do we do now!?
Right. What are Nie and the others doing now?
They should be heading to Castle Uroporos in the Goraon.
The Goraon?
Queen Elle of Rau's aura ship. It's our mothership.
Anyway, let's try contacting Nie.
Lady Elle. Word from Marvel at Karakara.
So, was Show at Karakara?
Yes, he apparently appeared suddenly with other surface machines.
I see...
So Lady Elle's vision was right.
What shall we do, Lady Elle?
The Goraon will continue to Castle Uroporos.
We cannot let Drake's army interfere with the Gran Garan's construction.
I told Show and the others to head for the Storm Sphere...
Right. We can't just leave Queen Sheela captive.
The Storm Sphere keeps moving. Can the Holy Warrior really find it?
In that case, tell Show Zama to come
to Castle Uroporos as well.
Understood, Lady Elle.
...Yeah, got it, we'll head there right away... Yeah, thanks, Nie.
Show, let's hurry and go help them.
...My friends are in a pinch. Everyone, please lend me your strength.
No need to be so formal. We'll help as much as you need.
Thank you so much.
Lady Sheela has been captured and swept up into the Storm Sphere.
And who is this Lady Sheela?
Sheela Lapana, queen of the Kingdom of Na in Byston Well.
Without the strength of the Kingdom of Na, there's no way to end
the war raging across Byston Well.
So we're going off to rescue this princess, huh?
She's a queen! Were you thinking about Princess Romina again?
No way.
That attitude isn't nice, Joe.
You've sure been taking Lenny's side a lot lately, Allenby.
Allenby and I are both maidens with troubled hearts, you know.
Exactly.
Geez. What'd I even do?
See? You just don't get it.
Mm-mm. Doesn't get it, doesn't get it.
This is why I don't get women. Not that I get Princess Romina either.
...That's right, what's going on up on the surface!?
Yeah. ...We have to get back as soon as we can...
Hey, Show, how did you end up coming to the surface?
...I'm not really sure. I was fighting Garalia, and suddenly...
Isn't there some surefire way?
If there's one possibility... it'd be to get help from Silky Mau,
who's being held in Drake's castle, like I mentioned before.
But, Show... even Silky might not be able to do it.
...Even if the odds are low, if it's all we've got, we do it.
Right... It's nice here, but we can't just sit around.
Yeah, and Mike's probably worried about us, too.
All right. We'll join up with Show's friends and head for Drake's castle.
